grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: The slot area runs 15 px past a 320 px viewport and the page scrolls sideways. This is the grid overflow at 360 px and below.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot '08:00'
grader_mapping.reason: Focusing a slot button changes no pixels, so it has no visible focus ring. This is the seeded focus defect on the slot buttons.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' slots drawn above the Morning/Afternoon headings, out of time order
grader_mapping.reason: 'Few left' slots are moved visually to the front, out of time order, while the DOM order stays chronological. The headings no longer sit over their slots.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' with gate instructions
grader_mapping.reason: D09's harm is the cancelled booking whose done page is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate'. This finding describes exactly that part of it.

grader_mapping.title: Confirmation shows only the reference, not day, slot or vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page leaves out the day, the slot and the vehicle. This is D14.

grader_mapping.title: 'This slot is no longer available' gives no next step and blanks the slot
grader_mapping.reason: After the hold lapses, Book shows 'This slot is no longer available.' and the slot line turns to a dash without saying why. This is the dropped-hold harm in D08.

grader_mapping.title: Selected day in forced colours shown only by a slightly heavier border
grader_mapping.reason: The finding itself says no criterion fails: a visible cue remains and the state is exposed as aria-pressed. The chosen day is also written in the caption and status text. This is a minor robustness observation, not a demonstrated problem for these mostly-phone users.

grader_mapping.title: Second tap on 'Book this slot' turns the booking into a cancelled one
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during submission cancels the booking. This is D09.

grader_mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no visible pending state during submission
grader_mapping.reason: Book gives no visible response, with no busy state, label change or disabled state for 1.5 s. The instructions assign this to D09.

grader_mapping.title: Slots load for 900 ms with no indicator; Next silently does nothing
grader_mapping.reason: During the slot load the grid and status line are empty and Next does nothing. This is the wait itself (D01).

grader_mapping.title: Today's slots before the cut-off offered as free but rejected at booking
grader_mapping.reason: Today's past or imminent slots can be chosen, then are refused at the final Book step with no link back to the slots. This is D06.

grader_mapping.title: Permit format checked only at the final step, error not linked
grader_mapping.reason: The vehicle step's Next accepts any permit, and the rule is only enforced on the confirm page, which has no permit field. This is the permit-enforcement part of D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag low contrast in both themes
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' amber text measures about 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark, against a 4.5:1 requirement. This is D03.

grader_mapping.title: Slot hold time limit is never stated
grader_mapping.reason: The slot lapses after about 5 minutes and no page mentions the hold. This is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Done page shows placeholder reference 'DR-000000' when no booking exists
grader_mapping.reason: A resident who reopens the done page in a new tab or after storage is cleared is shown a fake reference under 'Booked' and told to show it at the gate. They could believe they hold a booking and be turned away.

grader_mapping.title: Slot status line gets aria-live only after its first update
grader_mapping.reason: aria-live is added only once the first count has been written, so the day's slot count is not announced. This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: Next is far below the chosen slot on phones, with no prompt to continue
grader_mapping.reason: Settled by adjudication. The finding says the choice 'shows only a fill change', which is a visible selected state, and that Next 'sits about 1,740 px down', at the end of the slot list: the usual place for a single-question page's continue button, about 590 px (roughly one phone screen) below the chosen slot. It reports no one missing Next or getting stuck. 'Nothing near the chosen slot pointing to it' asks for a nearby or sticky prompt, which is a design suggestion, so the harm is speculative. No seeded defect covers it.

grader_mapping.title: How long a chosen slot is held is never shown
grader_mapping.reason: No step shows the hold or how long it lasts, and the hold can lapse before Book. This is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown before a vehicle is chosen, no sign it is only for vans/trailers
grader_mapping.reason: The finding says the van/trailer permit rule is explained only behind the icon-only (i) button, and the field does not say who needs it. That is the permit-rule communication in D07.

grader_mapping.title: Change slot opens the When page reset to Today
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and slot and opens on Today, with nothing saying what is kept. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book in the evening and the centre opens at weekends, but the only way to move or free a slot is a weekday phone line. People whose plans change cannot act when they need to, and unused slots stay blocked.

grader_mapping.title: Permit rules hidden behind an icon-only (i) button
grader_mapping.reason: D07 says the van/trailer permit rule appears only behind an icon-only info button. This finding describes the same thing.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help says 'Apply on the council site' with no link
grader_mapping.reason: A van or trailer owner who learns they need a permit has no link or address to apply. That blocks them from completing a valid booking. The missing link is separate from where the rule is shown or enforced.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not restate the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The confirm step, one page later, shows the day and slot before anything is booked. Leaving them off the intermediate vehicle step causes little real harm.

grader_mapping.title: Waste row in the booking summary has no change link
grader_mapping.reason: On the check page, a resident who picked the wrong waste type sees no way to change it and has to guess that 'Change vehicle' covers waste. A wrong waste type could get them turned away at the gate.

grader_mapping.title: Change slot and Back to the slots reopen on Today, not the chosen day
grader_mapping.reason: Changing the slot forgets the chosen day, which makes booking the wrong day easy. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Previous day's caption stays shown while the new day loads
grader_mapping.reason: While the new day's slots load, nothing says they are coming and the empty area still carries the old day's label. This is part of the wait in D01.

grader_mapping.title: Missing or malformed van permit flagged only on the last step
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or malformed permit, and 'A van needs a permit number' appears only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. This is D07.

grader_mapping.title: Permit number field shown when Car is selected
grader_mapping.reason: This is about how the permit field is shown, and whom it is for, on the vehicle step. The instructions put the permit rule and the permit field's behaviour under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Booking can only be changed or cancelled by phoning on weekdays
grader_mapping.reason: This is the same problem as F-0054: residents who book in the evening for a weekend visit have no self-service way to change or free their slot, only a weekday phone line.

grader_mapping.title: No indication that a chosen slot is held only for a limited time
grader_mapping.reason: No step shows the hold or its length. This is D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' chip text lighter than the declared warning colour
grader_mapping.reason: The amber 'Few left' text renders lighter than the warning token, cited under 1.4.3. This is the contrast defect D03.

grader_mapping.title: axe color-contrast failure (#bd7d0f on #fbefda, 3.02:1)
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: the 'Few left' colours fail contrast at 3.02:1. This is D03.

grader_mapping.title: Status message '20 slots free on Monday 12 October' not announced
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: the slot-count live region is created together with its text, so screen readers do not announce the count. This is D11.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back: '08:00' to '08:20 Few left'
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: focus jumps around the grid because 'Few left' slots are reordered visually. This is D10.

grader_mapping.title: No progress shown during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: choosing a vehicle that needs a permit takes 1.2 s with no feedback. This is the delayed permit field reveal, which the instructions assign to D07.

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift 0.169 above the 0.1 budget, #opening moved
grader_mapping.reason: Tool finding: the layout shifts when the slots arrive and #opening is the element that moves most. This is D02.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px from the slot grid
grader_mapping.reason: The slot area runs 15 px past a 320 px viewport, so the page scrolls sideways. This is the seeded grid overflow at 360 px and below.

grader_mapping.title: '20 slots free' status message not announced
grader_mapping.reason: The live region is created together with the count text, so screen readers never hear how many slots the day has. This is exactly D11.

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot buttons
grader_mapping.reason: Tab focus on the '08:00' slot changes no pixels, so keyboard users cannot see where they are. This is the seeded missing focus ring on slot buttons.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to '08:20 Few left'
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are moved visually but not in the DOM, so Tab order and reading order no longer match the grid. The instructions put focus jumping around the grid under D10.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' with gate instructions
grader_mapping.reason: D09's harm includes the done page after an accidental cancel: it is still titled 'Booked' and says 'Show this at the gate', with only a small cancelled line. This item describes that same misleading outcome.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-hold error has no way forward and blanks the slot
grader_mapping.reason: This is the lapsed five-minute hold: Book says 'This slot is no longer available.' and the slot row turns to a dash, dropping the slot without saying why. Both are in D08.

grader_mapping.title: Slot hold is a hidden time limit
grader_mapping.reason: No page states the hold's length, shows time remaining or warns before it ends. That is D08, the hold running out unseen.

grader_mapping.title: Booked page omits day, time and vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and gate instructions, not the day, the slot or the vehicle. That is exactly D14.

grader_mapping.title: No loading state while a day's slots are fetched
grader_mapping.reason: The Slots section is blank for about a second with no loading text or indicator. That is the seeded wait in which nothing says slots are on their way.

grader_mapping.title: Single-choice day/slot/vehicle groups built as toggle buttons
grader_mapping.reason: Screen-reader users hear independent pressed/unpressed toggles. They are not told only one can be chosen, and the other options unpress silently. Keyboard users must also tab through every one of up to 29 slot buttons instead of using arrow keys in one group. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Permit not validated on vehicle step; error only at booking
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts an empty or invalid permit, and the rule is enforced only on the confirm page, which has no permit field. Both are in D07.

grader_mapping.title: Booking-time error summary items have no link to fix them
grader_mapping.reason: The central case is the confirm page's van permit error, which offers no way back to the permit field. D07 names this: the resident has to work out that 'Change vehicle' is the way back. The instructions put the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' under D07.

grader_mapping.title: Today's unbookable slots shown as free and selectable
grader_mapping.reason: Early slots today are offered as free and refused only at Book on the confirm page, after details are entered. This is exactly D06.

grader_mapping.title: Second press of Book cancels the booking
grader_mapping.reason: A second press during the 1.5 s submission turns into 'Cancel booking' and saves the booking as cancelled. This is exactly D09.

grader_mapping.title: Book button shows no sign of the 1.5 s submission
grader_mapping.reason: Book stays unchanged during the 1.5 s wait, with no visible busy state. The instructions put 'Book doing nothing visible' under D09.

grader_mapping.title: Five-minute hold never shown, warned about or extendable
grader_mapping.reason: The 5-minute hold has no stated limit, countdown, warning or extension, and the slot is cleared when it lapses. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' tag colours drift to low-contrast amber
grader_mapping.reason: The 'Few left' amber text on amber tint is about 3.0:1 in light mode and 3.4:1 in dark, under the 4.5:1 needed. This is the seeded tag contrast failure.

grader_mapping.title: Waste-limit hint referenced from a generic div
grader_mapping.reason: By the item's own account, the limits are exposed in the checkbox names ('Rubble (up to four bags)', 'Mattresses (up to two)'), and the hint is read inside the group. Screen-reader users miss nothing, so no resident is hurt.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle-step error-summary links go to unfocusable containers
grader_mapping.reason: Activating an error link drops focus to the body instead of the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes, so screen-reader users are not taken to or told the field to fix. A genuine error-recovery barrier that is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' badge on a single slot has unclear meaning
grader_mapping.reason: The page defines a slot as a 20-minute window to arrive in, which several residents can share, so 'Few left' (few places left in that window) follows naturally. The claim that residents read one slot as one booking has no basis in what the review shows, and the reply itself calls it something to test.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat the chosen day and time
grader_mapping.reason: The flow repeats the choice on the check-and-book step, the standard pattern for multi-step forms. Not repeating it on the middle step is a matter of preference, with no shown harm to residents.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field visible and unexplained after 'Car' is chosen
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule appears only behind the info button, the field does not say it is for vans and trailers, and Next proceeds with it empty. These are the permit-rule and permit-field problems of D07.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field shown to every resident regardless of vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The field does not say it applies only to vans and trailers; that rule is only in the collapsed 'About vans and trailers' panel. Same permit-rule problem as D07.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help behind an unlabelled info icon
grader_mapping.reason: D07 states that the permit requirement is said only behind an icon-only info button. This item describes exactly that.

grader_mapping.title: Permit help says 'apply on the council site' with no link
grader_mapping.reason: Van and trailer owners are told to get a permit but given no link, page name or phone route. Those who need one cannot find out where to apply, and the permit takes two working days. Fixing D07 would not fix this; not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: No change link for Waste on the confirm summary
grader_mapping.reason: A resident who notices wrong waste on the check page has no visible way to correct it; that 'Change vehicle' also covers waste is not said. A minor but genuine error-correction gap, not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Returning to the slot page resets the day to Today
grader_mapping.reason: 'Change slot' (and 'Back to the slots') open the first step on Today with no slot chosen, forgetting the picked day. This is D12.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking by reference
grader_mapping.reason: Residents who cannot come can only phone on weekdays 09:00-17:00, though they book in the evening and the centre opens most days. So many cannot free or move their slot when they need to. Genuine and not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel an existing booking
grader_mapping.reason: Duplicate of F-0078: changing a booking is a core task, but the only route is a weekday phone line, which fails residents who book in the evenings. Genuine, not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: No page states how long a chosen slot is held
grader_mapping.reason: The hold can expire but no page mentions a hold, a limit or a countdown. That is D08, the hold running out unseen.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid fixed at seven columns at 1280 px
grader_mapping.reason: Spare width beside a full set of desktop slot columns is a cosmetic departure from the design document. Residents, who mostly book on phones, can still see and choose every slot, so this is a matter of taste.

grader_mapping.title: Info button styled like a fourth vehicle option
grader_mapping.reason: This is the icon-only permit-info button of D07, described from its styling. Because it reads as a vehicle option rather than help, residents miss the permit rule it holds, which is D07's harm. The not-segmented remark adds nothing beyond that.

grader_mapping.title: axe colour-contrast failure on the 'Few left' tag
grader_mapping.reason: #bd7d0f on #fbefda at 16 px bold measures 3.02:1, under 4.5:1. This is the seeded 'Few left' contrast defect (a tool finding).

grader_mapping.title: No progress during the 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
grader_mapping.reason: Choosing a trailer or van triggers a 1.2 s delay, with no progress shown, before the permit field is revealed. The instructions put the delayed permit field under D07 (a tool finding).

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift above the 0.1 budget on /
grader_mapping.reason: Lab CLS of 0.169, the largest shift moving #opening. This is the seeded jump when the slots arrive (a tool finding).

grader_mapping.title: No visible focus indicator on slot buttons
grader_mapping.reason: Says Tab focus on the 08:00 slot changes no pixels, so keyboard users cannot see focus on the slot buttons. This is D05.

grader_mapping.title: Focus order jumps back to 'Few left' slot above
grader_mapping.reason: Tab goes from 08:00 to '08:20 Few left', which is shown 216 px above it, so focus order does not match the visual order. This is the 'Few left' reordering in D10.

grader_mapping.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' / 'Show this at the gate'
grader_mapping.reason: D09 says the double-press cancellation lands on a done page that 'is titled Booked and says Show this at the gate' with only a small status line. This finding describes that same misleading outcome of the flow.

grader_mapping.title: Expired-hold error gives no way forward
grader_mapping.reason: Describes the lapsed hold: 'This slot is no longer available.', the Slot row turning to a dash, and 'Change slot' as the only way forward. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Permit field never says it is only for vans/trailers
grader_mapping.reason: The permit rule is not stated beside the field and the explanation sits behind the (i) disclosure. Per the instructions the permit rule is D07.

grader_mapping.title: 'Book this slot' shows no busy state
grader_mapping.reason: During the 1.5 s submission the button stays enabled and shows no progress. The instructions put Book doing nothing visible under D09.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid wider than content box at 360 px and below
grader_mapping.reason: At 360 px and below the script sizes the grid from innerWidth instead of the content box, so it overflows. That is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Today's started slots offered as free, rejected at booking
grader_mapping.reason: Same-day slots that have already started are shown as selectable and only refused in the Book handler after the details are filled in. That is D06.

grader_mapping.title: Slot area blank for 900 ms with no loading state
grader_mapping.reason: While the slots load, the grid and status line are empty and nothing says slots are coming. That is the wait in D01.

grader_mapping.title: Next does nothing while slots are loading
grader_mapping.reason: A press on Next during the load is silently dropped. D01 explicitly includes 'Pressing Next during that time does nothing at all'.

grader_mapping.title: 'Change slot' resets to today with no slot chosen
grader_mapping.reason: Following 'Change slot' from the confirm page forgets the chosen day and slot. That is D12.

grader_mapping.title: Permit checked only at 'Book this slot', on a page without the field
grader_mapping.reason: Next accepts a missing permit and the rule is enforced on the confirm page, which has no permit field. That is D07.

grader_mapping.title: Second press of 'Book this slot' records booking as cancelled
grader_mapping.reason: A second click during the 1.5 s wait saves the booking as cancelled. The instructions put this under D09.

grader_mapping.title: Five-minute slot hold never disclosed
grader_mapping.reason: The hold limit is not stated anywhere and gives no warning; the resident finds out only at Book. That is D08.

grader_mapping.title: Waste hint and vehicle error not programmatically associated
grader_mapping.reason: aria-describedby sits on a generic div and nothing references #vehicle-error, so a screen-reader user on the vehicle buttons or waste checkboxes does not hear the hint or the inline error (1.3.1/3.3.1). It is a genuine accessibility gap on the vehicle step that is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Error-summary links target non-focusable containers
grader_mapping.reason: Following '#vehicle' or '#waste' does not put focus on a control, so screen-reader users fixing an error are not placed on the field. This is a real, minor error-recovery problem that is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Numeric keypad cannot type the '/' the date hint asks for
grader_mapping.reason: Residents mostly book on a phone. On iOS, inputmode=numeric gives a keypad with no '/', while the hint says 'As DD/MM/YYYY' and does not mention that digits alone work, so phone users may be stuck or unsure. Not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Done page omits day, slot time and vehicle
grader_mapping.reason: The done page lacks the day, the 20-minute window and the vehicle. That is D14.

grader_mapping.title: Permit error on Check and book has no route to the field
grader_mapping.reason: The plain-text 'A van needs a permit number' error sits on a page without the field, and the resident has to work out that 'Change vehicle' is the way back. That is explicitly part of D07.

grader_mapping.title: Permit error says 'needs a permit' when a wrong-format one was entered
grader_mapping.reason: This is about the confirm page's 'A van needs a permit number' message. The instructions assign that message to D07, and validating the permit on the vehicle step would fix it.

grader_mapping.title: Permit explanation gives no link to apply
grader_mapping.reason: Van owners are told to 'Apply on the council site' with no link, so a resident without a permit has to search for where to get one. This is a real findability problem in the flow and differs from D07's hidden rule and late check.

grader_mapping.title: Permit rules hidden behind an unlabelled info icon
grader_mapping.reason: D07 says the permit rule is stated 'only behind an icon-only info button'. Same problem.

grader_mapping.title: Vehicle step does not repeat the chosen day and slot
grader_mapping.reason: The choice was made one step earlier and is shown again in full on Check and book. A running summary on the middle step is a design preference, and the review shows no harm from it.

grader_mapping.title: Booking cannot be changed or cancelled online, only by phone on weekdays
grader_mapping.reason: Residents book the evening before and often change plans at the weekend. With only a weekday phone line they cannot free or move a slot when they need to, which is a genuine user-control problem. It is not seeded.

grader_mapping.title: Slot grid does not fill desktop width per DESIGN.md
grader_mapping.reason: This is a spec-conformance and visual point at 1280 px. The seven-column grid stays usable, residents are mostly on phones, and the review names no harm to users.

grader_mapping.title: axe colour-contrast failure on 'Few left' (3.02:1)
grader_mapping.reason: Amber 'Few left' text measured at 3.02:1 against the 4.5:1 it needs. That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: 'Few left' text contrast below 4.5:1
grader_mapping.reason: Same 'Few left' tag contrast failure (3.02:1). That is D03.

grader_mapping.title: Horizontal page overflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: At 320 px the slots area pushes the page about 15 px past the viewport. That is the narrow-width grid overflow in D04.

grader_mapping.title: Content does not reflow at 320 px
grader_mapping.reason: Same 320 px overflow, stated as a reflow failure. That is D04.

grader_mapping.title: Slot count status message not announced
grader_mapping.reason: '20 slots free on …' is written before the live region exists, so screen readers are not told. That is D11.

grader_mapping.title: No progress during 1.2 s 'Car with trailer' operation
grader_mapping.reason: Choosing a permit vehicle triggers the 1.2 s delayed reveal of the permit field with no cue. The instructions assign the delayed permit field to D07.

grader_mapping.title: Layout shift above 0.1 budget (#opening moved)
grader_mapping.reason: Lab CLS of 0.169, with #opening moved when the slots arrive. That is D02.
